artifacts_produced.description: Comprehensive quality test report synthesizing all audit findings

files_modified.change: Added consolidated issue registry with 22 issues classified by severity

critical: C1: No Cancel API Endpoint - users cannot stop running tasks programmatically
C2: useGenerate lacks abort capability - single generation cannot be stopped from frontend
C3: Style Guide severely abbreviated (~50 words vs ~2000 words in Python)
architectural_strengths: Unified BaseAgent interface with clean abstraction
Explicit state machine for session management
Prompt version control for all agents
regressions_from_python: Style Guide compression affecting output quality
Hardcoded style guide vs file-based loading

immediate: Expand style guide to full NeurIPS 2025 content
short_term: Use pointer references for image data to reduce memory
Complete i18n coverage in EmptyState and ErrorBoundary
Implement graceful Python shutdown in PlotExecutor

warnings: Critical issues C1-C3 must be fixed before production release
Memory pressure during critic iterations needs monitoring
Frontend-backend SSE field structure needs alignment
